from pathlib import Path
import os, subprocess, json, hashlib, shutil, time
ROOT = Path('D:/project/zan-lang')
HERE = ROOT / '_scratch/finally-sharing'
HERE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
BASE = ROOT / 'build/zanc-finally-before.exe'
if not BASE.exists():
    shutil.copy2(ROOT / 'build/zanc.exe', BASE)
    (HERE / 'baseline-sha.txt').write_text(hashlib.sha256(BASE.read_bytes()).hexdigest() + '\n')

def source(n):
    lines = ['using System;', 'class FinallyScale {', '    static long cleaned;', '    static async int Run(int seed) {', '        try {']
    for i in range(n):
        lines.append(f'            if (seed == {i}) {{ return seed + {i}; }}')
    lines.extend(['            return seed + 100;', '        } finally {'])
    for i in range(n):
        lines.append(f'            cleaned = cleaned + seed + {i};')
        if i % 4 == 3:
            lines.append('            await Task.Yield();')
    lines.extend(['        }', '    }', '    static async void Main() {', '        long sum = 0;', f'        for (int i = 0; i <= {n}; i = i + 1) {{ sum = sum + await Run(i); }}', '        Console.WriteLine("sum=" + Convert.ToString(sum));', '        Console.WriteLine("cleaned=" + Convert.ToString(cleaned));', '    }', '}', ''])
    return '\n'.join(lines)

def measure(compiler, label, n):
    src = HERE / f'scale-{n}.zan'
    text = source(n)
    if src.exists():
        assert src.read_text() == text
    else:
        src.write_text(text)
    exe = HERE / f'{label}-{n}.exe'
    manifest = HERE / f'{label}-{n}.json'
    for p in (exe, manifest):
        if p.exists(): p.unlink()
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env['ZAN_CODEGEN_MANIFEST_JSON'] = str(manifest)
    started = time.monotonic()
    result = subprocess.run([str(compiler), str(src), '--auto-stdlib', '--publish', '--check-leaks', '-o', str(exe)], cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=180)
    elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
    (HERE / f'{label}-{n}.compile.log').write_bytes(result.stdout)
    assert result.returncode == 0 and exe.exists() and manifest.exists(), result.stdout.decode(errors='replace')
    run = subprocess.run([str(exe)], cwd=ROOT, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=30)
    (HERE / f'{label}-{n}.run.log').write_bytes(run.stdout)
    expected = f'sum={n*n+100}\ncleaned={n*(n+1)*(2*n-1)//2}\n'
    assert run.returncode == 0 and run.stdout.decode().replace('\r\n','\n') == expected, run.stdout.decode(errors='replace')
    functions = json.loads(manifest.read_text())['functions']
    resume = next(f for f in functions if f['name'] == 'FinallyScale_Run$resume')
    evidence = {'scale':n, 'label':label, 'compiler_sha256':hashlib.sha256(compiler.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'wall_seconds':elapsed, 'resume':resume, 'output':expected}
    (HERE / f'{label}-{n}.evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(evidence, indent=2))
    print(json.dumps({'label':label,'scale':n,'insns':resume['insns'],'blocks':resume.get('blocks'),'seconds':round(elapsed,3)}), flush=True)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    import sys
    label = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'before'
    compiler = BASE if label == 'before' else ROOT / 'build/zanc.exe'
    for n in (8, 16, 32): measure(compiler, label, n)
